# Absolute Pest Services

> Absolute Pest Services is a local, licensed and insured pest-control and humane wildlife-removal company based in West Grove, Pennsylvania. Its primary service area is Chester County, Pennsylvania and northern Delaware (New Castle County), with coverage in nearby southeastern Pennsylvania communities.

## Contact

- Website: https://absolutepestservices.com/
- Request service: https://absolutepestservices.com/request-service
- Primary phone: +1-484-643-2225
- Northern Delaware phone: +1-302-235-1975
- Email: info@absolutepestservices.com
- Google Business Profile: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=6448368082287234615

## Services

- General extermination and recurring pest control
- Ant, cockroach, spider, and household-insect control
- Wasp, hornet, yellow-jacket, and other stinging-insect removal
- Termite inspection, treatment, and prevention
- Bed bug inspection and treatment
- Mouse and rat control
- Carpenter bee treatment
- Bat exclusion
- Humane wildlife trapping, removal, exclusion, and entry-point repair

## Primary service area

- Chester County, Pennsylvania, including West Chester, West Grove, Kennett Square, Avondale, Oxford, Exton, Downingtown, Coatesville, Cochranville, Landenberg, Lincoln University, and nearby communities
- Northern Delaware / New Castle County, including Wilmington, Newark, Hockessin, Pike Creek, Bear, Glasgow, and nearby communities
- Additional nearby service areas are listed at https://absolutepestservices.com/service-areas
